editorial.description_en: Hemp rope, used: warm, mid, and darker than the cloth it is twisted from.
editorial.description_ja: 使いこんだ麻縄のような、あたたかみのある灰色。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.676, C 0.026, h 82.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 麻 (asa, hemp) + 縄 (nawa, rope). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Hemp Rope" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 麻縄. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — hai-suna at ΔE00 8.5, kare-wara at ΔE00 8.9, sawa-ishi at ΔE00 9.4. complementary is empty because at chroma 0.026 the hue is not a reliable enough statement to oppose. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
